newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank in $300 mln paper program.
newsitem.headline: Maybank in $300 mln paper program.

text.p: Malaysia's Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) said on Wednesday it was launching a $300 million commercial paper program.
It said in a statement that Merrill Lynch Money Markets Inc would be the arranger for the issue.
The program will allow Maybank to issue notes of up to 270 days tenure.
The notes would either be priced at a discount or, if interest bearing, at par.
Merrill Lynch and Morgan Stanley & Co would be the dealers in the program, Maybank said.
The statement did not say when the issue was expected.
